sources.title: 京张铁路遗址公园沿线人工智能创新街区重点地区街区控规草案公示采信情况通告

sources.limitations: This public notice reports consultation and adopted responses; it does not expose a complete machine-readable redline or parcel-control dataset. The proposal does not derive its provisional geometry from this notice.

sources.title: 京张铁路遗址公共空间改造提升工程（一期）实施方案批复

sources.limitations: The approval is project-level context, not a current cadastral, engineering, or full corridor control layer. The exact URL is retained as published by the issuing authority.

sources.title: 京张铁路遗址公共空间改造提升工程（二期）配套项目完工

sources.limitations: A project update does not publish a complete GIS base, ownership layer, or detailed design control set.

sources.title: Amap POI and geocoding cross-check
sources.path: tool result: POI text search and geocoding
sources.usage: Cross-checks public place anchors and transit context for AI Origin Community, Jingzhang Railway Heritage Park segments, and Dazhongsi station.
sources.collection_method: Read-only Amap MCP text-search, geocoding, nearby-search, and POI-detail calls; no map tiles, photos, or POI geometry were copied into the package.
sources.coverage: AI Origin Community: Chengfu Road 45-1, 116.334173,39.994622; Qinghua Science Park East POI Q1: 116.332497,39.992943; Wudaokou Metro Station POI Q2: 116.337742,39.992894; Jingzhang Railway Heritage Park Wudaokou segment: 116.338277,39.991769; Dazhongsi station, Lines 12/13 POI P3: 116.345139,39.966612; Dazhongsi Metro Exit E POI Q3: 116.343183,39.967969; Information Management School POI Q4: 116.348418,39.965526.
sources.limitations: The park is returned as multiple public POI segments, and search is ambiguous for the name 众智园. Provider data may change. This record is QA/background only; its place anchors cannot define official boundaries, land use, areas, or engineering controls.

sources.title: Amap walking connectivity cross-check
sources.path: tool result: walking route and distance calls
sources.usage: Tests a representative walking chain from AI Origin Community through the Wudaokou park segment and onward to Dazhongsi station.
sources.collection_method: Read-only Amap MCP walking-route and distance calls using the geocoded AI Origin Community, Wudaokou park-segment, and Dazhongsi station anchors.
sources.coverage: Using the Wudaokou park POI at 116.338277,39.991769 as the representative park anchor: AI Origin Community to park 636 m / 509 s; park to Dazhongsi station 3,451 m / 2,761 s. Returned route instructions mention Chengfu Road, Heqing Road, Zhongguancun South 5th Street, Zhichun Road auxiliary road, Dazhongsi East Road, Sidaokou Road, and Beisanhuan West Road auxiliary road.
sources.limitations: The park is a linear, multi-segment POI, so these are current route observations for one representative anchor, not a measured design metric, official accessibility survey, or proposed road alignment.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap road and place context extract
sources.usage: Provides named public road centerline context, transit nodes, parks, and schools beneath the proposal layers so the design can be read against recognizable city fabric.
sources.collection_method: Read-only Overpass API extract for named roads and public places inside the provisional display window; source geometry is retained as a context layer with attribution.
sources.coverage: 成府路、荷清路、暂安处西街、中关村南五街、知春路、大钟寺东路、四道口路、北三环西路；五道口、大钟寺、北京北 transit nodes; 京张铁路遗址公园 and public-school place polygons where returned.
sources.limitations: OpenStreetMap is community-maintained and may be incomplete or stale; this context layer does not establish legal road boundaries, ownership, parcel status, or engineering conditions.

sources.title: Esri World Imagery public aerial context
sources.publisher: Esri and the GIS user community
sources.usage: Aerial context beneath the overview map so a reader can recognise the surrounding roads, blocks, rail corridors, water, and green spaces before reading the proposal marks.
sources.collection_method: Read-only ArcGIS World Imagery export for the shared display window 116.300,116.380,39.936,40.030; the downloaded raster is retained as a display reference and is not used to derive legal geometry.
sources.license: Esri World Imagery service terms; attribution retained on the figure and in this source record.
sources.coverage: Public aerial context for the Jingzhang corridor display window, including the AI Origin Community, Jingzhang Railway Heritage Park segment, and Dazhongsi station surroundings.
sources.limitations: Imagery date, resolution, and positional accuracy vary by tile; it is not a cadastral, statutory, engineering, or heritage-control base map.
